intro: Job applications take forever. Hiresprint makes them fast.
match: Every job posting shows your match score,
with the skills you have, and the ones you're missing.
tailor: Tailor your resume in one click.
Your own bullets, in the job's words. Your match goes up.
And your resume keeps its design.
autofill: The whole application fills in seconds.
Plus a cover letter for this exact job.
Review and submit. Fifteen minutes, down to one.
ats: Run an ATS check to see how hiring systems read your resume, and what to fix.
studio: Save answers like salary once, and reuse them everywhere.
outro: Hiresprint. Free on the Chrome Web Store.
